About.description: Who we are, and how we help students find a safe, verified PG bed in Delhi NCR.
About.intro: We help students find a safe, verified PG bed near their college in Delhi NCR, and move in without the usual risks.
About.why: Finding a PG is hard on students and parents. Brokers ask for large advances to "arrange a room"; photos often look nothing like the room; some deposits are never returned. We think booking a bed should be safer than that, and cost students nothing.
About.verified: We visit every PG ourselves before we list it, and check its safety: the exits, fire extinguishers, the building's condition and who looks after it.
About.honest: Prices are honest: the full monthly rent, the deposit and every charge you must pay, shown before you book. No fake countdowns, no made-up scarcity.
About.free: Students pay nothing to use us. Owners pay a one-time fee when we find them a tenant.
About.token: When booking opens, your token is small, refundable and protected until you've moved in and checked the room.

TokenProtection.title: How your token is protected
TokenProtection.description: A small, refundable token that counts toward your rent, held until you've moved in and checked the room.
TokenProtection.intro: Your token is small, refundable, and it counts toward your rent.
TokenProtection.soon: Reserving a bed opens soon. Until then, you can book a visit to any PG we list.
TokenProtection.smallTitle: A small token, not an advance
TokenProtection.small: You reserve a bed with {token}, never more. It counts toward your first month's rent. Never pay a broker a large advance to "arrange a room".
TokenProtection.heldTitle: No money moves until you've moved in
TokenProtection.held: We hold your token until you've moved in and had {checkHours} hours to check the room.
TokenProtection.notAsShownTitle: Not as shown? Your money back the same day
TokenProtection.notAsShown: If the room isn't as shown, tell us within those {checkHours} hours: your token is released or refunded the same day, and we'll help you find another verified bed.
TokenProtection.cancel: Cancel for free up to {freeCancelDays} days before you move in, and get your whole token back.
TokenProtection.confirm: The owner confirms your reservation within {confirmHours} hours. If they don't, your token is refunded in full.
TokenProtection.safe: You pay through an RBI-authorised payment gateway, to our registered company: never to a personal UPI ID. Owners are paid through the gateway's own settlement, never from a pool of other people's money.
TokenProtection.throughUsTitle: Only when you pay through us
TokenProtection.throughUs: These protections cover money paid through {brand}. Money paid to an owner or a broker directly is outside them.
